geometry.charged_sites: r_a=(+x,-x,+y,-y,+z,-z), radius 1, spin up/down on each site, canonical fermionic CAR
geometry.electronic_orbitals: s_a=1/sqrt(6); p_ai=r_ai/sqrt(2); Ps=ss^T, Pp=pp^T, Pd=I-Ps-Pp. The two even d-like octahedral orbitals are retained, not deleted.
geometry.neutral_orientor: Four states |0>,|x>,|y>,|z>; n_i=(|0><i|+|i><0|)/sqrt(3), (Ln_i)_jk=-i epsilon_ijk on the odd triplet. This is a finite quantum neutral orientor, NOT a classical imposed orientation.
geometry.rotation_scope: Finite octahedron has cubic symmetry and inversion, not exact SO(3). Neutral l=1 generators are microscopic inputs. Full H does not commute with the proposed continuous total angular momentum when g !=0, because electronic even d-like sector does not contain a complete l=2 shell. Doublets/quartets are cubic/Kramers multiplets; j=1/2 and j=3/2 are approximate character labels, not exact full-space angular momenta.

parity: Physical parity is electronic site inversion times diag(+1,-1,-1,-1) on neutral orientor. The odd dressed doublet is primarily even electronic s times odd NEUTRAL orientor, not a pure electronic p orbital.

source_conventions.units: hbar=site radius=|elementary charge|=1; energies/frequencies in hopping-energy units; q is inverse radius; epsilon is unit dimensionless polarization
source_conventions.charge: Electron physical charge is Q=-N. Code current uses number/link-phase convention A_phase=-A_EM; J_code=-partial H/partial A_phase=i[H,R] at q=0; physical electromagnetic charge current J_EM=-J_code. spin_current is number-spin flux; multiply by -1 for charged-spin flux. Contact has two source derivatives and is unchanged by this sign reversal.
source_conventions.finite_q_phase: For every offsite hop a<-b, H_ab(A_phase)=h_ab exp(i integral_(r_b to r_a) A_phase(r).dr). Straight-link f_ab(q,eps)=(eps.(r_a-r_b)) exp(i q.(r_a+r_b)/2) sinc(q.(r_a-r_b)/(2 pi)). Local orientation and rotor-spin couplings carry no electronic Peierls phase because they are onsite.
source_conventions.current: J_ab(q,eps)=-i h_ab f_ab tensor I_spin tensor I_neutral, second quantized in exact N-sector. J(q,eps)^dagger=J(-q,conj(eps)). No midpoint approximation in f.
source_conventions.contact: C_ab(out,in)=-h_ab conj(f_ab(qout,epsout)) f_ab(qin,epsin), lifted identically. This is the actual mixed second derivative, not a fitted Thomson term.
source_conventions.spin: Js_i={S_i,J_code}/2. Primitive spin is not conserved: dS_i/dt=i[H,S_i] transfers angular momentum to neutral orientor. Charge Ward/continuity is not a spin-conservation assertion.
source_conventions.magnetic: The actual orbital Peierls phase for uniform magnetic field in phase convention is phi_ab=(B_phase.(r_b cross r_a))/2. Stored ground_orbital_magnetic_moment_z=-partial H/partial B_phase is flux/number moment. PHYSICAL electron magnetic moment has the OPPOSITE sign because B_phase=-B_EM. No spin Zeeman term was installed.
